text:
maria: FYI PR #2145 is blocked on linux-e2e flaky test. Trying to land before Wed deploy-freeze. Any rebase window tonight or early tomorrow?

devon: I can take a rebase slot around 23:30 UTC. CI queue looks long though. If we rebase we should also rerun the integration cache.

sam: saw the flake, it's the new fixtures seed. I pushed a quick fix to the branch, but need a clean run to confirm. Reran job once: `ci/linux-e2e` -> failed on timeout.

jen: Heads up deploy-bot posted freeze schedule earlier: `Wed 00:00 - Thu 06:00 UTC`. If we're landing before that we need allchecks green by 23:50 latest. :warning:

maria: thanks. Devon, if you can rebase at 23:30 I'll kick a full matrix run. Can someone watch the queue? If it stalls we should swap to canary plan.

devon: I'm around. I'll rebase and push. Command I'll run: ```git fetch origin && git rebase origin/main && ./scripts/ci-trigger.sh --full-matrix```

sam: i'll monitor and restart any flaky job. If linux-e2e flakes again, try `--workers=2` (helps with resource contention).

jen: +1 on monitoring. Also ping @product if the ship slips past freeze; they need to know for the Thursday demo.

deploy-bot: Reminder: upcoming deploy freeze starts at 2024-11-13T00:00:00Z. Emergency exceptions require eng-lead + infra-ops approval.

maria: Noted. If CI finishes by 23:45 we'll go for it. If not, plan B: postpone until after freeze and schedule canary for Fri AM.

devon: Rebase started at 23:31 UTC. Pushing now.

sam: rerun kicked at 23:33 UTC. Watching `ci/linux-e2e` and `ci/integration`.

(devon): `ci/linux-e2e` passed on retry at 23:50 UTC. `ci/integration` still running.

jen: If integration looks healthy by 23:55 we can mark for merge exception. Who will request exception if needed?

maria: I'll file the exception and loop eng-lead. If it's green we'll merge and watch canary.

sam: integration finished 23:56 — all green. Great job team.

devon: landed at 23:58 UTC. :tada:

maria: thank you! Leaving a note in the PR about the flake and mitigation steps.

jen: Awesome. Adding postmortem note to the release checklist about flaky fixtures seed.

maria: closing thread — feel free to ping me if any rollback signals appear in canary. :eyes:
